On VTES-L, Dave Stevers <daves...@HOTMAIL.COM> wrote:
> To LSJ,
> I just need to have a few rulings confirmed.
> -Can Change of target be used immediately after a Kiss of Ra?

No. The action is blocked (by Kiss of Ra), meaning the action is
unsuccessful. The acting minion is not blocked (meaning: is not
intercepted), which is required for Change of Target.

> -When someone wants to block a +1 stealth bleed action directed at
> another Meth. with a 2nd. T. and an Eagles Sight, do they have to Wake
> to be able to play the Eagle's or can they just 2nd. and then
> Eagle?

They have to wake. They cannot just play 2nd tradition, since they
are not capable of blocking at that time, so they do not need the
intercept.

> -Does Derange make a Camarilla vampire a Sabbat vampire? (For things
> like Protect Thine Own)

Yes. Any time a vampire changes clan to a clan of a different sect,
his sect changes to the new clan's sect.

> -Can a Malkavian Freak drive after performing an action out of turn
> using the Madness Network? And is it true that you can play action
> and Action Modifiers when taking actions using the Network? I assume
> that you can't use reaction cards when taking actions with the Network.

All true.

> -Can "stolen" blood be used to heal aggravated damage?

Yes.

> -For Brujah Debate, if more than 1 Brujah is your eldest vampire, do you
> tap just one or all?

Just one.
